about_item: 【Your All-Day Comfort Solution】 Premium Ergonomic Desk Chair with Footrest featuring dynamic 3D lumbar support, 5D Flip-Up Armrests, and extra-wide 3D breathable headrest, 2-position angle foot-rest, perfect for home office chairs seeking ultimate comfort

【Engineered with Dynamic Spinal Alignment System】3D Synchro-Tilt Lumbar（Lockable ±1.6" depth spring-loaded auto-tracking/±2" height/15° rotation）with force-sensitive springs mimics natural spine curvature, certified by AEP* for 12hrs+ fatigue reduction in high back ergonomic chairs (*American Ergonomics Partnership)

【Smart Space-Saving Features】 5D Flip-Up Armrests with skin-friendly panels - 27% denser EVA foam padding achieves Zero-Pressure Contact, it can be adjusted at Height/width/forward/backward/rotate/flip function, a space-saving flip-up design that tucks neatly under standard desks

【Advanced Adjustability】 3-stage reclining mechanism pairs with an 18" extendable footrest (2-position angle adjustment) for seamless transition between work mode and relaxation in home office desk chairs, while 28cm³ 3D AirFloat Headrest with cervical curve mapping reduces 31% neck strain

【Breathe Easy with Premium Ventilated Mesh】The exclusive Dual-Stripe AirMesh technology offers 38% better airflow and 25% higher elasticity than standard mesh, making it a durable and breathable mesh office chairs.

【Orthopedic-Engineered for Active Recovery】 Born from collaboration with California-based orthopedic specialists, the X100 ergonomic mesh office chair features a Dynamic Spine Alignment System. This isn't just sitting—it's active recovery. The 17-point micro-adjustment system, combined with synchronized lumbar and tilt mechanisms, actively supports your spine's natural movement, promoting better posture and circulation during long hours of use.

【Professional & Gaming Ready】 The ELABEST X100 ergonomic gaming chair is engineered to excel in any environment. Seamlessly transition from focused work to immersive gaming with a chair that understands dual-purpose design. Its adaptive support and robust construction make it the perfect all-in-one throne for coders, creatives, streamers, and professionals who demand versatility without compromising on comfort or performance.

【Certified Safety & Heavy-Duty Support】 Crafted with a BIFMA-certified structure that robustly holds up to 300 lbs. It features a heavy-duty Grade-4 central column paired with an integrated step-on footrest nylon base and whisper-quiet rolling casters, ensuring seamless vertical adjustment and rock-solid stability for long hours of seating.

【Hassle-Free Assembly & 5-Year Quality Support】 No need to hunt for tools – we've included everything you need. Get it set up in around 15 minutes, then adjust the seat height (18.3–23") to find your perfect sitting position, backed by our dedicated 5-year satisfaction care.
